transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____ . What brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. Well, I came in because I've been doing some things lately at work and school that just... they don't really make sense. 

I work as a bookkeeping clerk, and I've started doing stuff like lining receipts all across the floor instead of filing them. Or I'll sit there and tap the calculator in sets of nine. Sometimes I'll even just stand by the copier with my hands held up in the air, and I just stay like that until someone walks by and asks if I'm okay. 

It's pretty weird and it's getting in the way of things, so I figured I should come in and talk to someone about it.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t?

Yeah, actually, I have. Not seeing things, but hearing them. 

Sometimes when I'm just alone at my desk at work, or walking home from class, I'll hear a man's voice. He says things like, "check line seven," or "you missed the sign." It sounds completely real. It's clear enough that I actually stop and look around to see who said it, even though nobody is there.
Have you had any times when your mood was very high or very depressed at the same time as these voices or unusual behaviors?

Yeah, they actually do happen together. Like, a while back, there was a period of a few weeks where I was barely sleeping at all. I just had all this energy and felt like I needed to start all these new plans and projects. And right in the middle of all that, I was still hearing the voice. That was also when I started feeling completely sure that the invoice numbers at work were sending me secret messages. So, yeah, the high energy and the voice and everything else... they were all happening at the exact same time.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you were hearing voices or having unusual beliefs, but your mood was not very high or very depressed?

Yeah, actually, I have. Um... there was a stretch of time, maybe for a few weeks, where my mood felt pretty normal. I was sleeping fine, I didn't have all that crazy energy, and I wasn't feeling down or anything either. 

But even then, I was still hearing the voice. And I still felt completely pulled into those number patterns and the secret messages. So, yeah, the weird stuff with the numbers and the voice kept happening even when my mood was completely fine.

latest_inference.note: Mood symptoms and psychotic symptoms have both occurred, and there has also been a period of at least two weeks of psychosis without mood symptoms, which rules out pure bipolar disorder with psychotic features and supports schizoaffective disorder. Catatonic and schizophreniform/schizophrenia diagnoses are less likely given the clear mood episode alongside psychosis.
